Commentary.Commentary: India for sure will be winning the Silver Medal now! It will be interesting to see who they face in the finals. The second semi finals will be coming up shortly. It is a clash between Pakistan and Sri Lanka. That game begins at 1130 IST (0600 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

INDIA STORM INTO THE FINALS THEN! It was never in doubt after they bundled Bangladesh Women out for just over 50. They did lose a couple of wickets chasing a low score but this was never in doubt after the end of the first innings. Bangladesh could be happy with the fact that they did not let India just smash them around for the 50 odd runs but they will be mighty disappointed with their performance which was quite poor. Just nothing went their way and they were beaten by a far superior side.
Two! There are the winning runs! INDIA WIN BY 8 WICKETS! Shorter and outside off, this is cut wide of deep point for two.
